variant_definitions.A: SVD axis: pc1_centroid (locked) / pc2_centroid / pc2_cellpca / pc3_cellpca (centroid SVD has rank<=2 with 3 classes, so PC3 is defined on the per-cell cloud)
variant_definitions.M: marker panels: P0 stored van Zyl scores, P1 canonical mini, P2 DEG/LPC data-driven; metrics rho_data (arm-invariant), rho_marker_axis (PC1 alignment), rho_centroid_marker (locked axis vs marker gradient)
variant_definitions.R: rank assignment: R0 [0,1,2] locked; R1 [1,2,3]; R2 [3,2,1]; R3 [2,1,3]; R4 [1,2,4]; Spearman is rank-invariant -> R1==R0, R4==R0, R2==-R0 (verified)

verdict_thresholds.verdict: ROBUST if both; PARTIAL if one; NOT_REPRODUCED
